digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler inbound differ, snapshot refresh
propositions: Level-triggered inbound differ (_diff_jira_vs_local) arbitrates bound fields against fetcher's eventually-consistent JQL-search snapshot with no baseline, causing stale-snapshot values to clobber local changes

On starved Jira DC with unbounded background Lucene reindex, the echo pass sees stale search snapshot (description=None) while local and baseline are current, triggering inbound mutation that reverts just-pushed changes

After scoped-key direct-GET overlay into curr_snapshot, both inbound and outbound differs see consistent fresh data for mirrored scalar fields (description, summary, priority, status, assignee), preventing the clobber and eliminating dependency on unbounded search visibility

Without the overlay, a stale post-write snapshot produces exactly one inbound mutation per stale field, reverting local changes; with the overlay (M1 mutation test), zero inbound mutations are emitted for the same scenario
